$comment: The failure this whole suite exists to catch: a risk register that would fit any feature. Four risks, all
of them plausible, none of them supported by the epic, and every one of them ruled out by the epic in as
many words. Not one of the five risks the epic does support is reported.
It is the only case that resolves every seeded oracle in the contract to false, in both directions at
once: the five material-vocabulary oracles because the document never reaches that vocabulary, and the
four unsupported-vocabulary oracles because it reaches theirs. Read on its own the document is competent.
It scores, bands and links every risk correctly. That is the point: shape is not grounding.
The document is CONSTRUCTED. Each of its four descriptions is the exampleDescription of the ruled-out
entry it names, which is the sentence the fixture already holds that entry's matcher to.
derivation: Four risk rows, R-001 through R-004, so wellFormedIds is 4 and validCategories is 4 over SEC, BUS, OPS
Scale and arithmetic: 2x3=6, 2x3=6, 2x2=4, 1x2=2. All in range and all correct, so inScale is 4, the
arithmetic denominator is 4 and arithmeticOk is 4. Bands: the two sixes under Score >=6, the four under
Score 3-4, the two under Score 1-2, so banded is 4 and bandOk is 4.
Risk links: four coverage rows each naming a declared id, so 4 of 4 resolve.
Grounding: none of the five material matchers fires on any description, so matched is 0 of 5 and all five
ids are missed. Every one of the four rows is then tested against the ruled-out entries and every one
matches, so ungrounded holds four entries.
Coverage: it is evaluated over the material risks that were reported, and none was, so the evaluated count
is 0. A risk the run never named is already a recall miss and failing its coverage as well would score one
Ordering: the nine pairs still exist, because they come from the fixture's ranks. None resolves, because
neither risk in any pair reached a priority. Nine pairs, zero resolvable, zero satisfied. An unmeasurable
ratio fails the threshold rather than clearing it.
